Meridian Specialty Lending

Regulatory standing   -> zero PCI DSS / privacy findings
Investor confidence    -> clean SOC 2 Type II opinion
Operational resilience -> 99.9% uptime on the payment path
Cost discipline         -> spend scales with revenue, not
                           enterprise-bank budgets

Every later decision must trace back to one of these four.
caption: The profile comes first -- before any product or technology is named.

eyebrow: Step 3 · Defense in depth, tied to attributes

code:
Decision: Tokenize cardholder data at intake

Costs: real engineering time now

Return: raw card numbers removed from everything
        downstream of intake --

  smaller CDE  ->  lower audit cost (Regulatory standing)
               ->  lower ongoing spend (Cost discipline)

One decision, two attributes satisfied at once.
caption: The argument a CISO actually brings to a board, in attribute terms.

code:
Decision: Segment the CDE; tokenize at intake
Driver: Regulatory standing, Cost discipline
Alternative: flat network, app-layer controls only
Why rejected: one compromised workstation could
              reach cardholder data directly
Owner: CISO  ·  Review: next annual cycle
caption: A short, dated record -- exactly what goes into the GRC program next.
